# Cully v0.5.0

Run `cully codex` to start Codex with a live Cully advisor pane below it. The launcher owns the terminal and confines Codex to the upper half, so it needs no terminal multiplexer. The lower pane shows bounded tool counters and suggestions about repeated failures, broad searching, and edits that need a check. In short terminals, Codex keeps the whole screen.

The Codex `PostToolUse` hook runs asynchronously and records only tool classes and failure flags while the pane is open. It does not save prompts, commands, tool output, or transcripts, and removes its local session files when the launcher exits.

Codex setup now leaves native footer choices to the user and no longer installs a blocking `Stop` hook. Rerun `cully agent setup codex` after upgrading to remove older Cully-managed footer and stop-hook entries while preserving user-owned settings. The session-start continuity hook, Cully skill, and `/prompts:cully` command remain available.

The installation guides now use the agent selector consistently. The customer setup test also exercises the published Cully CLI.
